abstract: The World Economic Forum's Future of Jobs Report 2023 examines employers' expectations regarding workforce disruption. The report finds that employers estimate 44% of workers' core skills will be disrupted over the next five years, highlighting significant labor market transformation driven by technological change and evolving business needs.
keyFindings: Employers estimate that 44% of workers' core skills will be disrupted in the next five years
methodology: Not specified in provided excerpt. The Future of Jobs Report typically surveys employers globally on workforce trends, skills demand, and labor market expectations, but specific methodology details are not available in the source text provided.
qualifiers: Based on employer estimates rather than actual labor market outcomes; five-year projection involves inherent uncertainty; limited excerpt provided does not contain authors' stated caveats or scope restrictions.
